illustration.alt: A sealed package traveling safely between two computers

elementaryChecklist.centralJoke: The package takes a long trip just to become a pull request

preschool.title: A Safe Package
preschool.lesson: Computers can pass a locked package.
paragraphs: One computer sends a little package to another computer. It stays locked while it travels.

elementary.title: The Traveling Test Package
elementary.lesson: A checksum proves that a file arrived unchanged.
paragraphs: Vercel keeps this test package private while GitHub checks its special fingerprint. If the fingerprint matches, the package becomes a pull request for a person to review.

middle.title: Testing a Private Publishing Bridge
paragraphs: The worker uploads a completed ZIP with a narrowly scoped signed URL. The bridge hashes it on the server and gives GitHub a different short-lived URL that can only download that object.

high.title: An End-to-End Transport Fixture
high.lesson: Separate transport authorization from repository authorization.
paragraphs: A shared publishing token authenticates the worker without revealing the GitHub PAT. Private Blob delegation URLs constrain upload, download, and deletion independently, while SHA-256 binds ingestion to the exact uploaded bytes.
